selection_population_provenance_note: The supplied cohort archive does not include evidence of the size of the candidate population it was selected from.
cohort_readme: Preliminary revised cohort, 10 unique Synthea patients. Original bundles contain future events: never expose to inference without encounter-end filtering. Profiles contain historical conditions and prescription labels, not verified active discharge medications. Missing disposition is unknown, not home. Scale 1 is prototype default; no authorized Scale 2 case established. Initial vitals pending. All scenarios are synthetic proposals. IDs replace prior preliminary cohort IDs; do not mix versions. No FHIR import or clinical validation performed.
